Reading the workspace

  1. Requirements definition
  2. Interior Comfort & Materials

Interior materials that match the price class

Proposal
1, implement. Upholstery and trim is level A (20 rows) and supported by the study attribute interior material quality (5.62 vs 5.95); door panels add 19 rows. Owners compare the cabin with the previous generation and with Audi.
Horizon
H1. Material and option changes within the life-cycle impulse.
Domain
Interior Comfort & Materials
Markets
US
Evidence level
A (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G60-US-IC-03 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

Door panels, dashboard and trim within reach shall use soft-touch or leather materials, and a full-leather upholstery option shall be offered.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USStudy interior material quality (1-7)>= 5.95 (today 5.62, peer 5.95)Next US customer study waveevidence
USLeather upholstery optionAvailable on every variantOffer checkassumption

    FND-G60-US-EQ-upholstery_interior_trim

    'Upholstery / interior trim' draws 20 complaint rows (2 explicit wishes) for the BMW 5 Series Sedan (US), while the German catalogue (July 2026) offers 8 related item(s) that are not standard on every variant: Perforated Veganza upholstery | Black (standard on 9/10 variants); M Veganza/Alcantara Black (standard on 1/10 variants); Interior trim strips Dark Silver accent combined with Dark Graphite matt effect paint (standard on 9/10 variants); Interior trim strips M Dark Silver accent combined with Aluminium Rhombicle Dark Silver (standard on 1/10 variants); M leather steering wheel (standard on 1/10 variants); Perforated Veganza | Black (standard on 9/10 variants). Catalogue coverage is Germany-only and serves as a proxy for the offering.
